title: laburnum album
intro: Laburnum album, commonly known as the common laburnum or pea-flowers, is a flowering plant that belongs to the legume family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation, due to its sedative and calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Laburnum album are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, particularly cytisine, which have been found to have antispasmodic and diuretic properties. However, more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for human consumption.
